caption: The drawing is divided into two main sections. On the left is a color plan for a cottage garden, labeled with various plant types and features. The garden is approximately 150 feet long and 75 feet wide. At the bottom is a rectangular cottage with a pinkish-red roof, a porch, and two chimneys. Curved tan walkways surround the cottage and lead through areas labeled “Balsam Fir.” In the center section is a large lawn (“b”), represented by light green coloring with darker green clusters labeled as clumps of plants, and a heart-shaped “Rose Garden” (h) with a circular shape and a pink center. To the left of the lawn, there is a path labeled “Mignonette.” At the top, rectangular beds are labeled “Vegetables,” “Asparagus” (a), “Strawberries,” “Currants,” “Gooseberries,” “Raspberries,” “Cherries,” “Apricot,” and “Plum.” The paths and garden beds are outlined in brown and tan, and text labels are written in cursive. On the right side of the drawing is a vertical strip featuring detailed botanical illustrations. From top to bottom, there are various colored flowers (pink, white, red, and yellow), a brown pine cone, green branches, and a green fir tree. Each plant or flower is labeled, such as “Chinese Honeysuckle,” “Rose,” “Carolina Allspice,” and “Balsam Fir or Gillac.” The title "COTTAGE and PLAN of GARDEN by Andrew Jackson Downing" is written at the top of the right section. The overall composition uses shades of green, brown, pink, red, white, and yellow, combining both architectural and botanical elements.
title: Ground Plan for Cottage
